high_level_description: A PIXEL ART CAMPAIGN ROADMAP showing the ENTIRE Bloodridge region and a branching route through NINE DISTINCT SMALL ENCOUNTER LOCATIONS to ONE FINAL BOSS LOCATION. The nine locations form THREE successive left-to-right stages, each containing THREE alternatives arranged vertically: three sparse starting locations on the left, three modest burial-ruin locations in the middle, three richer courtyard locations further right. All routes converge on a single boss gate at far right. Ten locations total. The map is viewed zoomed out from a consistent oblique 2.5D game camera. Small environments are embedded in ONE continuous landscape, connected by clearly visible winding dirt paths which branch and cross between stages. The network of routes and distinct destinations is the main subject. Each location occupies only a small part of the map. Hand-drawn pixel-art environment, crisp intentional colour clusters, dusty worn ash-brown limestone, low-saturation sepia and grey-mauve shadows, corroded bronze and dry roots, like an aged Egyptian-inspired burial court. Architecture grows from bare minimum at the left to maximum only at the final boss.

compositional_deconstruction.background: One uninterrupted region of flat ash-earth and shallow eroded limestone outcrops, filling the canvas. The continuous terrain surrounds ALL ten encounter clearings. Small landmarks and paths share one fixed oblique projection and one pixel size. Distinct encounter clearings have ample terrain between them. The landscape is large compared with the little architecture. Worn pixel-art stone with irregular slabs and eroded edges, muted dusty browns and subdued grey-violet shadows. No sky. The left third is mostly bare earth with sparse pebbles; middle has modest small ruins; later has richer yet compact burial courtyards. The boss site is the richest, occupying only the far-right fifth of the picture.

elements.desc: A CLEAR BRANCHING ROAD NETWORK drawn as continuous pale dirt paths across the whole map. Three starting clearings on the left each connect forward to two of the three middle clearings. Three middle clearings each connect to two of the three later clearings, with obvious forks and crossroads in the spaces BETWEEN locations. The three later clearings all lead to the single boss courtyard at far right. Paths run over continuous flat terrain without cliffs blocking them. Clear separation between all nine little destination areas. The path network must be legible immediately when the whole image is viewed small.

Encounter location 1, FIRST stage, almost empty flat ash ground with ONE tiny chipped standing marker. One small distinct open clearing with a visible entrance path and exit path. This is one destination among NINE, not a separate panel. It sits naturally in the continuous ground, with substantial open terrain separating it from the other sites. All stone is chipped and weathered pixel art, never clean cubic blocks. Very sparse and unbuilt, almost entirely empty ground.
